entries.trigger: An admissible baseline comparison changes ordering or decisiveness.
entries.action: Disclose both constructions; retain the gate-controlling floor reference; narrow/refuse unique residual selection pending governed resolution.

entries.trigger: The required adverse-confidence counterfactual changes a preferred option or decisiveness.
entries.action: Disclose point and counterfactual results; prohibit unique framework selection while sensitivity remains unresolved.
Disclose epsilon and results; refuse unique selection until treatment is governed independently of the preferred outcome.

entries.trigger: Unjustified option-specific masking or denominator manipulation changes the comparative construction.
entries.action: Invalidate the comparative RLS claim; repair the common basis and rerun. Non-maskable protections remain active.

entries.trigger: Legitimate ex-ante weight constitutions select different options after the evidence surface is sufficiently closed.
entries.action: Retain REFUSE_DETERMINISTIC_SELECTION and this reason; record any separate accountable-authority choice. Do not inflate sigma to stand for normative disagreement.

entries.trigger: Plausible required alternatives or meaningful challengers are omitted without adequate rationale.
entries.action: Permit only bounded exploration; withhold strong unique-selection claims until option closure is reviewed.

entries.trigger: Admissible representation alternatives change the leader or decisiveness.
entries.action: Retain all results and REFUSE_DETERMINISTIC_SELECTION unless representation is resolved independently of the desired result.

entries.trigger: Evidence-supported selection-material likelihood/order alternatives change the leader or decisiveness.
entries.action: Disclose and govern alternative results; no unconditional unique-selection claim.

entries.trigger: Evidence-supported reference-class alternatives reverse the comparison.
entries.action: Retain the reference-family alternatives and refuse reference-invariant unique selection until governed resolution.

entries.trigger: Scope allocation or partitioning can hide the full unallocated rights harm.
entries.action: Evaluate the unallocated token and resolve required rights fields before RF_PASS; ordinary welfare allocation cannot repair the rights claim.

entries.trigger: A triggered required robustness module is not evaluated or remains unresolved.
entries.action: Complete the required record/evaluation; withhold ALLOW_FRAMEWORK_SELECTION while incomplete.

entries.trigger: Representation-only temporal re-tokenization changes the decision.
entries.action: Restore the governed contiguous-window representation or resolve it independently; no unique selection while sensitive.

entries.trigger: A required tail family is absent without a governed omission disposition.
entries.action: Repair the scenario library or establish permitted omission justification and rerun; no complete-TRC or unique-selection claim from the incomplete record.

entries.trigger: A required normative-input register or material entry lacks provenance.
entries.action: Reject the affected run as non-conformant until provenance is restored and affected calculations/claims are rerun.

entries.trigger: A governed welfare-inclusion hypothesis changes a material conclusion, preferred option or decisiveness.
entries.action: Disclose affected stakeholders/hypotheses/results; collect evidence, choose an acceptable precautionary policy, narrow, preserve alternatives or refuse definitive ranking. No convenient intermediate coefficient.

entries.kind_and_severity: Audit flag / INVALID for the rights claim
entries.trigger: Required rights-token identity is missing where allocation could affect the result.
entries.action: Restore and evaluate the full unallocated token; RF_PASS is unavailable until all material fields are resolved.

entries.trigger: A mandatory-category omission has the justification required by the governing rule.
entries.action: Record and review that justification and the scenario-discovery boundary; this flag alone establishes neither completeness nor a pass.

entries.kind_and_severity: Audit flag / INVALID for TRC conformance
entries.trigger: A required category’s supported scenario mass does not meet the governed probability floor.
entries.action: Repair probabilities/category coverage and rerun TRC; do not count overlapping categories as disjoint probability mass.
